text.description_html:
Bommer BB5004-450N-652, Brushed Chrome 4-1/2" x 4-1/2" Heavy Duty Ball Bearing Non-Removable Pin Hinge

Standard commercial size quad (4) ball bearing door hinge. Heavy duty door hinge, .180" thickness with non-removable pin for security. Standard full mortise hinge with 5 knuckle design and button tips. BHMA certified architectural grade hinges. Made in the USA.

Specifications for the Bommer BB5004-450N-652 4-1/2" Heavy Duty Ball Bearing NRP Hinge:

  • Finish: Brushed Chrome
  • Hinge Material: Steel
  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 4-1/2"
  • Corners: Square
  • 4 Ball Bearings for Smooth Action
  • Thickness: 0.180" (Heavy Duty)
  • Wood Screws: 4 ea. #12 x 1-1/4"
  • Machine Screws: 8 ea. #12-24 x 1/2"
  • BHMA Certified Hinge
  • Non-Handed
  • Non-Removable Pin
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Full Mortise - Conforms to ANSI A8111 for Ball Bearing Hinges
  • Bommer BB5004-450N Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

Package with matching finish machine screws and wood screws. For use with both metal and wood doors.

Sold Individually (1 door hinge)

** Clearance Priced, limited quantities available.

Only (3) Left.
